name: Ishihara Chinatsu
source:
She is Yuta's desk mate and student president. She usually has a very arrogant appearance and always makes things difficult for Yuta. But in fact, she has an unknown second year hobby... It seems that she is secretly conducting research on supernatural phenomena.

Her hobby is reading.
